If sister mk2 sweeper not yet wired, this creates an enforcement gap window — must verify mk2 substitute is live OR consumer chain is being deprecated wholesale.

n6 raw_archive bak files tier classification 'redundant' relies on git remote already containing them at commit 113725b0; if remote becomes unreachable (dancinlab org access lost) OR force-push rewrites history, the local copy would have been the only witness — anima archive fork is the resilience layer.

cp -Rp preserves POSIX mtime + mode but does NOT preserve macOS extended attributes (com.apple.metadata via xattr) or chflags (uchg/uappnd) flags — verified files have @ in ls (extended attrs present). Archive may be functionally identical but bit-for-bit different at xattr level — sha256 of file content matches; xattr divergence is acceptable for evidence purposes but should be documented.

sha256 manifest verification requires identical shasum binary across both source and archive contexts; on macOS /usr/bin/shasum is Perl-based whereas Linux uses coreutils sha256sum — cross-platform manifest comparison can produce trailing-whitespace divergence. Pin to /usr/bin/shasum -a 256 on macOS for both source + archive computation; never mix with sha256sum unless manifest is normalized.

Plist 'OnDemand=true' in launchctl list output is misleading — this is launchd's keepalive default, NOT user-facing on-demand. The actual cadence is StartInterval=600s (verified in plist body). Documentation must not conflate OnDemand=true with manual-trigger semantics.
